title: pg_hba.conf not readable: authentication exposure unverified
condition: Reading pg_hba_file_rules raised a permission error or the view is unavailable, so SEC-001, 002, 003, 006 and 007 are blind. Emitted in the META band so the reader knows.

title: No WAL archiving: point-in-time recovery impossible
condition: archive_mode = off on a self-managed primary. Skipped on managed platforms, where BAK-010 fires instead. Confidence medium: snapshot-based strategies exist, but pg_dump alone is not PITR.

title: archive_command is failing
condition: pg_stat_archiver.failed_count > 0 AND last_failed_time > coalesce(last_archived_time, -infinity). WAL cannot be recycled, pg_wal grows, and the server eventually PANICs when the volume fills.

title: WAL archiving stalled
condition: archive_mode is on and either at least 10 .ready files are queued in pg_wal/archive_status, or archive_mode is on with a non-zero archive_timeout and last_archived_time is older than max(1 h, 3 x archive_timeout).

title: archive_command is a no-op (WAL archived to nowhere)
condition: archive_mode is on and archive_command matches an effective no-op: 'true', '/bin/true', ':', 'exit 0', 'cd .', or a comment. Archiving reports success and keeps nothing.

title: Last successful base backup unknown or older than 7 days
condition: No backup tool output could be read (pgbackrest info, barman list-backups, wal-g backup-list) and the interview question is unanswered, so this fires with confidence low and details 'unverified'; or a tool reported the newest full/incremental as completed 7 or more days ago, or not OK.

title: Data or WAL volume 90 percent or more full
condition: df of the data directory or of pg_wal (following symlinks) shows 90% or more used. PostgreSQL PANICs when pg_wal cannot extend.

title: Data checksum failures reported
condition: pg_stat_database.checksum_failures > 0 in any database, including the shared-objects row. Reported by the server, not inferred.

title: zero_damaged_pages enabled
condition: zero_damaged_pages = on. Damaged pages are silently replaced with zeros on read, which is silent data loss.

title: ignore_checksum_failure enabled
condition: ignore_checksum_failure = on. Checksum mismatches are logged and the page is used anyway.

title: Corruption messages in the recent server log
condition: Any of: 'invalid page in block', 'could not read block', 'unexpected chunk number', 'missing chunk number', 'unexpected zero page', 'page verification failed', 'WAL contains references to invalid pages', 'PANIC' in the last 50 MB of server log. Crash-only patterns route to REL-011 instead.

title: fsync disabled
condition: fsync = off. Any operating-system crash or power loss can leave the cluster unrecoverable, not merely missing recent transactions.

title: full_page_writes disabled
condition: full_page_writes = off. Torn pages after a crash are unrecoverable unless the filesystem guarantees atomic 8 kB writes (ZFS does; ext4 and xfs do not).

title: End-of-life major version reachable from the network
condition: Derived: REL-001 and SEC-003 both fired. An unpatchable server is reachable from beyond the host.

title: Synchronous replication configured but no synchronous standby connected
condition: synchronous_standby_names is non-empty, no pg_stat_replication row has sync_state = 'sync' or 'quorum', and synchronous_commit is not 'off' or 'local'. Commits are hanging right now.

title: Inactive replication slot retaining more than 10 GB of WAL
condition: A slot with active = false whose restart_lsn is 10 GB or more behind the current WAL position, or whose wal_status is 'unreserved' (13+). pg_wal grows until the volume fills and the primary PANICs.

title: trust authentication reachable over the network
condition: A host, hostssl or hostnossl pg_hba rule with auth_method = 'trust' whose address is not 127.0.0.1/32 or ::1/128 and whose error column is null. Anyone who can reach the port is any role they name.

title: Transaction ID or MultiXact wraparound imminent
condition: greatest(age(datfrozenxid), mxid_age(datminmxid)) >= 1,500,000,000 for any database, including templates. At 2^31 the cluster refuses new XIDs and stops accepting writes.

title: Archiving enabled but no archive_command or archive_library set
condition: archive_mode <> off and both archive_command and archive_library (15+) are empty. WAL is retained forever and the log fills with warnings.

title: Connections at 90 percent or more of max_connections
condition: Client backends >= 0.90 x (max_connections - superuser_reserved_connections - reserved_connections). The next spike returns 'FATAL: sorry, too many clients already'.

title: Orphaned prepared transactions
condition: A row in pg_prepared_xacts prepared 1 hour or more ago. Prepared transactions hold locks and the xmin horizon indefinitely, survive restarts, and are invisible in pg_stat_activity.

title: Inactive replication slot retaining more than 1 GB of WAL
condition: A slot with active = false retaining between 1 GB and 10 GB of WAL.

title: Streaming replica lagging badly
condition: pg_wal_lsn_diff(sent_lsn, replay_lsn) >= 1 GB or replay_lag >= 5 minutes for a connected standby. A failover now would lose minutes of data or take minutes to complete.

title: Standby not streaming
condition: In recovery and either pg_stat_wal_receiver is empty or its status is not 'streaming' while restore_command is empty; or the receive-to-replay gap is 1 GB or more (replay stalled).

title: Sequence or integer key at 90 percent or more of its range
condition: last_value / effective_max >= 0.90, where effective_max is min(max_value, the maximum of the owning column's type: 32,767 / 2,147,483,647 / 9.22e18). Inserts fail with 'nextval: reached maximum value' or 'integer out of range'.

title: Cleartext password authentication over the network
condition: A host or hostnossl pg_hba rule with auth_method = 'password'. The password crosses the network in the clear.

title: Autovacuum disabled
condition: pg_settings.autovacuum = off. The emergency anti-wraparound vacuum still runs, which is why this is P5 and not P1, but nothing else does: bloat and stale statistics grow without bound.

title: Statistics tracking disabled (autovacuum blind)
condition: pg_settings.track_counts = off. Autovacuum cannot see dead tuples, so only anti-wraparound vacuums will ever run.

title: synchronous_commit off cluster-wide
condition: synchronous_commit = off at server level. Bounded loss of up to about 3 x wal_writer_delay (600 ms by default) on a crash. Often deliberate; always worth knowing about.

title: Blocking chain: session blocked more than 5 minutes
condition: A backend with a non-empty pg_blocking_pids() that has been waiting since state_change for 5 minutes or more. Details name the root blocker, its state, transaction start and query fingerprint.

title: Idle in transaction for more than 1 hour
condition: A backend in state 'idle in transaction' (or 'idle in transaction (aborted)') since state_change 1 hour or more ago. It holds locks and the xmin horizon, and blocks DDL and vacuum.

title: Server restarted within the last 24 hours
condition: now() - pg_postmaster_start_time() < 24 hours. Every counter-based check is low confidence, and the reason for the restart is itself worth knowing (see REL-011).

title: Replication slot invalidated or lost
condition: pg_replication_slots.wal_status = 'lost' (13+), or conflicting = true (16+), or invalidation_reason is set (17+). The consumer must be re-initialised; the slot still exists and misleads anyone reading the topology.

title: Logical subscription disabled or erroring
condition: pg_subscription.subenabled = false; or enabled with no worker pid in pg_stat_subscription; or pg_stat_subscription_stats.apply_error_count/sync_error_count > 0 (15+). Data diverges while the publisher's slot keeps retaining WAL.

title: Published table without a usable replica identity
condition: A table published for UPDATE or DELETE with relreplident = 'n'; or 'd' with no primary key; or 'i' with no valid replica-identity index. UPDATE and DELETE on the publisher error out.

title: Transaction ID or MultiXact age high
condition: greatest(age(datfrozenxid), mxid_age(datminmxid)) >= 1,000,000,000 and < 1,500,000,000 in any database. Five times the default freeze age: autovacuum has been trying and failing for a long time.

title: wal_level = minimal
condition: wal_level = minimal. No archiving, no streaming replication and no online base backup are possible without a restart.

title: Data or WAL volume 80 percent or more full
condition: As CAP-001 at 80% or more and below 90%.

title: Projected disk-full within 30 days
condition: Growth measured between two saved snapshots projects 100% usage within 30 days. Confidence low with fewer than 7 days between snapshots.

title: Collation version mismatch (index corruption risk)
condition: pg_database.datcollversion differs from pg_database_collation_actual_version() (15+), or pg_collation.collversion differs from pg_collation_actual_version() (13+). A glibc or ICU upgrade changed sort order under existing text indexes, so index lookups can miss rows.

title: Client transaction open for more than 1 hour
condition: A client backend whose xact_start is 1 hour or older, excluding maintenance statements (VACUUM, CREATE INDEX, REINDEX, CLUSTER, COPY) and base-backup application names. It holds the xmin horizon, which is what VAC-005 measures.

title: shared_buffers at the shipped default
condition: shared_buffers <= 128 MB. The shipped default is sized to start anywhere, not to run anything. Managed platforms size it themselves, so this almost always means an untuned self-managed server.

title: Major version past end of life
condition: The running major version's end-of-life date in reference/versions.yml is in the past. No security fixes are issued. Escalates to REL-002 at P1 when SEC-003 also fired.

title: Crash or OOM-kill evidence in the recent server log
condition: Any of 'was terminated by signal 9', 'server process ... was terminated by signal', 'database system was not properly shut down', 'terminating any other active server processes' in the recent log. Deep pass only.

title: autovacuum_freeze_max_age raised to 1 billion or more
condition: autovacuum_freeze_max_age >= 1,000,000,000 or autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age >= 1,000,000,000. Halves the safety margin and lengthens the emergency freeze window.

title: archive_timeout unset on a low-write primary
condition: archive_mode is on, archive_timeout = 0, and no pg_receivewal is connected. The current segment may not ship for hours, so the recovery point objective is undefined. 60-300 s is a typical setting.

title: Restore never tested, or RPO/RTO undocumented
condition: The answer to 'when was the last successful restore test?' is more than 90 days ago, never, or unknown; or RPO/RTO are not stated.

title: Connections at 70 percent or more of max_connections
condition: Client backends >= 0.70 x usable max_connections, below the CONN-001 threshold.

title: max_connections very high with no evidence of a pooler
condition: max_connections >= 500 and neither a known pooler application_name (pgbouncer, pgpool, pgcat, odyssey, supavisor, rds_proxy) nor 80% of connections arriving from 3 or fewer addresses. Each backend is an operating-system process.

title: Sessions currently waiting on locks
condition: At least 10 sessions with wait_event_type = 'Lock' at snapshot time. See LOCK-001/002 for the chain.

title: Data checksums disabled
condition: current_setting('data_checksums') = off. Silent storage corruption cannot be detected. Enabling requires pg_checksums with the cluster shut down (12+) or a logical rebuild.

title: Invalid index
condition: pg_index.indisvalid = false or indisready = false. Left behind by a failed CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY: maintained on every write, never used by the planner, and if unique it still blocks conflicting inserts.

title: Unused index 1 GB or larger
condition: idx_scan = 0, size >= 1 GB, statistics age >= 30 days, and the index is not unique, primary or a replica identity. Usage counters are per instance: verify on every replica before dropping.

title: Duplicate indexes
condition: Two or more indexes on the same table identical in indkey, indclass, indoption, indexprs, indpred and uniqueness. Pure write amplification and storage waste; keep the one backing a constraint.

title: Estimated B-tree bloat over 50 percent (500 MB or more wasted)
condition: Catalog-only estimator: estimated index bloat >= 50% and >= 500 MB wasted. Estimated, not measured. Fix with REINDEX INDEX CONCURRENTLY (12+).

title: Unindexed foreign key on a large table
condition: A foreign-key constraint with no index whose leading key columns equal conkey in order, on a child table of 100 MB or more. A parent DELETE or key UPDATE then sequentially scans the child under a share lock, and at this size one such scan is expensive whatever the parent's write rate is. The write-activity tier is PG-IDX-018; everything below both is PG-IDX-009.

title: Large table with heavy sequential scans
condition: Table 1 GB or larger, seq_scan >= 100 since reset, average rows per sequential scan >= 100,000, and sequential scans are at least 5% of all scans. Confidence medium: batch jobs scan legitimately.

title: Blocking chain: session blocked more than 30 seconds
condition: As LOCK-001 but with a wait of 30 seconds or more and less than 5 minutes.

title: Idle in transaction for more than 5 minutes
condition: As LOCK-003 but 5 minutes or more and less than 1 hour.

title: Worst-case memory commitment exceeds RAM (OOM risk)
condition: shared_buffers + max_connections x work_mem x max(2, hash_mem_multiplier) + autovacuum_max_workers x coalesce(autovacuum_work_mem, maintenance_work_mem) >= RAM. The OOM killer takes out the postmaster, not the offending backend. Fires at P100 with the computed figure when RAM is unknown.

title: Inactive replication slot
condition: A slot with active = false retaining less than 1 GB. The consumer may be gone for good; details include inactive_since (17+), slot type and output plugin.

title: Streaming replica lag moderate
condition: pg_wal_lsn_diff(sent_lsn, replay_lsn) >= 100 MB or replay_lag >= 30 s, below the REPL-006 thresholds.

title: Slot WAL retention unbounded
condition: PostgreSQL 13 or newer, at least one replication slot exists, and max_slot_wal_keep_size = -1. A dead consumer can then fill the WAL volume and take down the primary. Size a cap to the volume, for example 20-50 GB.

title: Standby streaming without a slot while wal_keep_size is 0
condition: A pg_stat_replication row whose pid is not any slot's active_pid, while wal_keep_size (or wal_keep_segments before 13) is 0. Any network interruption that outlasts checkpoint recycling forces a rebuild of that standby.

title: Standby query conflicts high
condition: On a standby, total pg_stat_database_conflicts divided by days since stats reset is 100 per day or more. Queries are being cancelled; consider hot_standby_feedback (and its primary-side bloat cost) or a larger max_standby_streaming_delay.

title: Synchronous standby with high flush lag
condition: A standby with sync_state = 'sync' whose flush_lag is 1 second or more. Every commit on the primary waits that long.

title: WAL senders or replication slots at capacity
condition: Connected WAL senders >= max_wal_senders, or existing slots >= max_replication_slots. A new standby or a base backup cannot connect.

title: Sequence or integer key at 70 percent or more of its range
condition: As SCHEMA-001 but between 70% and 90%. Time to plan the bigint migration, which is a full table rewrite on a large table.

title: Listening on all interfaces with world-open HBA rules
condition: listen_addresses is '*', '0.0.0.0' or '::' AND a host rule matches 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0, 'all' or 'samenet' for database 'all'. Confidence low: a firewall or security group may be in front; the report asks.

title: SSL disabled while accepting non-local connections
condition: ssl = off and listen_addresses is not localhost-only. Credentials and data travel in clear text.

title: Application connections running as superuser
condition: At least 5 concurrent client connections, or any connection from a non-local client_addr, under a superuser role whose application_name is not an interactive client (psql, pgAdmin, DBeaver, DataGrip, db-triage).

title: User tables granting write privileges to PUBLIC
condition: A relation in a user schema with INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE granted to PUBLIC. Every role that can connect can write to it.

title: Autovacuum running more than 6 hours on one relation
condition: A pg_stat_progress_vacuum row whose backend xact_start is more than 6 hours old. With default cost settings autovacuum moves roughly 8 MB/s of dirty pages; a run this long means the table needs per-table cost settings or partitioning.

title: Autovacuum workers saturated
condition: Running autovacuum workers equals autovacuum_max_workers AND at least 20 tables in this database currently exceed their vacuum threshold. Both conditions are required so an idle cluster that happens to have 3 workers busy does not fire.

title: Tables overdue for vacuum
condition: n_dead_tup > 2 x the table's effective vacuum threshold (autovacuum_vacuum_threshold + autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor x n_live_tup, honouring reloptions) AND n_dead_tup >= 100,000 AND pg_relation_size >= 100 MB. Top 10 by n_dead_tup.

title: Large tables never analyzed or with stale statistics
condition: (last_analyze and last_autoanalyze both null and n_live_tup >= 100,000) OR (n_mod_since_analyze > 0.2 x n_live_tup and n_live_tup >= 1,000,000). The planner is flying blind on exactly the tables where it matters.

title: Old transaction horizon holding back vacuum
condition: age() of the oldest xmin across pg_stat_activity.backend_xmin, pg_replication_slots.xmin/catalog_xmin, pg_prepared_xacts and pg_stat_replication.backend_xmin is >= 50,000,000 (25% of the default freeze age). Vacuum cannot remove anything newer than that xmin anywhere in the cluster.

title: Estimated table bloat over 50 percent (1 GB or more wasted)
condition: Catalog-only estimator: estimated bloat >= 50% AND estimated wasted bytes >= 1 GB on relations >= 1 GB. Estimated, not measured; confirm with pgstattuple_approx before any rewrite.

title: Checkpoints mostly requested (max_wal_size too small)
condition: At least 20 checkpoints since the statistics reset and requested / (requested + timed) >= 0.5. Every requested checkpoint restarts full-page writes; the default max_wal_size of 1 GB is small for any real write load.

title: pg_wal directory unusually large
condition: Sum of pg_ls_waldir() sizes >= max(3 x max_wal_size, 50 GB). This is the symptom; the cause is BAK-002/003, REPL-002/003, or a large wal_keep_size.

title: Anti-wraparound vacuum overdue
condition: age(datfrozenxid) > 1.5 x autovacuum_freeze_max_age (or mxid_age > 1.5 x autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age) and < 1,000,000,000. The forced vacuum should have run at 1.0x, so something is blocking freezing.

title: Tables driving transaction ID age
condition: Emitted for the current database when WRAP-001/002/003 fired: the top 10 relations by greatest(age(relfrozenxid), mxid_age(relminmxid)), with size and whether a vacuum is currently processing them.

title: Managed-platform backups not verifiable from SQL
condition: A managed platform was fingerprinted. Confirm in the provider console that automated backup retention is greater than 0 and PITR is enabled: on RDS a retention period of 0 disables backups entirely.

title: Base backup running for more than 2 hours
condition: A pg_stat_progress_basebackup row whose elapsed time exceeds 2 hours, or whose phase has not advanced. Informational context for the operator: it explains load and WAL retention.

title: Temp-file volume high
condition: pg_stat_database.temp_bytes divided by the statistics window is 50 GB/day or more. Pairs with MEM-004 and QRY-009, and is a disk-space risk while MEM-009 holds.

title: Most connections idle
condition: At least 100 client connections and 80% or more in state = 'idle'. Application-side pools sized for peak; a transaction-mode pooler reclaims the memory.

title: High connection churn
condition: pg_stat_database.sessions divided by the statistics window is 10 sessions/second or more cluster-wide. PostgreSQL forks a process per connection, so churn burns CPU and adds latency.

title: Sessions ending abnormally
condition: (sessions_fatal + sessions_killed + sessions_abandoned) / sessions >= 1% with at least 10,000 sessions. Clients are being rejected or are dropping connections.

title: No integrity-verification tooling installed (amcheck)
condition: amcheck is listed in pg_available_extensions but not installed in this database. This is the PostgreSQL analogue of never running a consistency check.

title: synchronous_commit weaker than the synchronous-standby expectation
condition: A standby has sync_state = 'sync' while synchronous_commit is 'local' or 'remote_write'. The standby may lose the last transactions on a crash even though the topology says it will not.

title: Unlogged tables present
condition: Any relation with relpersistence = 'u'. Contents are truncated on crash recovery and are never replicated to a standby.

title: Overlapping indexes (leading-column prefix)
condition: Index A's key columns, opclasses and options are a strict prefix of index B's, with the same predicate, A not unique and neither an expression index. A is usually redundant, but prefixes are sometimes deliberate (INCLUDE columns, sort order), so this is P100 not P50.

title: Write-heavy table with many indexes
condition: At least 10 indexes on a table with 1,000,000 or more writes since the statistics reset. Every insert and every non-HOT update touches every index.

title: Unindexed foreign key on a write-active parent
condition: As PG-IDX-008 but the child is smaller than 100 MB: the referenced table takes 10,000 or more updates plus deletes a day averaged over the statistics window, and the child holds 100,000 or more rows. That is on the order of 100 seconds a day of constraint-check sequential scanning plus a KEY SHARE lock on the child for each parent write. A rate, not a lifetime counter: 1,000 writes since a reset four months ago is eight a day and means nothing. A child that has never been analyzed has no row estimate and is not evaluated here - PG-VAC-004 is the check for that.

title: idle_in_transaction_session_timeout disabled
condition: idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 0 at server level with no role override. 5-15 minutes is a reasonable value for application roles.

title: Active query running more than 10 minutes
condition: A client backend in state 'active' whose query_start is 10 minutes or older, with the same maintenance exclusions as LOCK-005. It may be legitimate analytics; it is listed so the reader can decide.

title: shared_buffers above 40 percent of RAM
condition: shared_buffers > 40% of RAM. Double-buffering with the operating-system cache, and heavier checkpoints. Skipped when RAM is unknown.

title: work_mem at the default with heavy temp-file spill
condition: work_mem <= 4 MB and either temp_bytes >= 10 GB/day or temp_files >= 1,000/day across the scanned databases. Raise it per role rather than globally, because of MEM-003.

title: maintenance_work_mem at the default on a large database
condition: maintenance_work_mem <= 64 MB while the scanned databases total 100 GB or more. Index builds and, before 17, vacuum dead-tuple storage are throttled by it.

title: effective_cache_size at the default
condition: effective_cache_size is 4 GB with source = 'default'. The planner under-values index scans, because it believes only 4 GB is cached anywhere.

title: Huge pages not in effect with a large buffer cache
condition: shared_buffers >= 8 GB and either huge_pages_status = 'off' (17+) or huge_pages = off. Page-table overhead and TLB misses scale with the buffer cache.

title: temp_file_limit unlimited
condition: temp_file_limit = -1. One runaway sort or hash join can fill the data volume.

title: pg_stat_statements not available
condition: pg_stat_statements is not in shared_preload_libraries, or is preloaded but not created in this database. Without it there is no per-query workload view and every other QRY check is skipped. Enabling the preload needs a restart.

title: One statement dominates execution time
condition: A single queryid accounts for 25% or more of the sum of total execution time, with at least 1,000 calls. Tune this one before anything else.

title: Statements spilling to temp files
condition: A statement with 1 GB or more of temp_blks_written since the statistics reset; top 5. Pairs with MEM-004: raise work_mem for the role that runs these, not globally.

title: High transaction rollback ratio
condition: xact_rollback / (xact_commit + xact_rollback) >= 0.10 with at least 10,000 transactions. Application errors, or an aborted-transaction retry loop.

title: JIT overhead significant
condition: Sum of jit_generation_time + jit_inlining_time + jit_optimization_time + jit_emission_time is 5% or more of total execution time. Common on OLTP workloads where jit has been on by default since 12.

title: Major version within 6 months of end of life
condition: End-of-life date minus today is 180 days or fewer. Major upgrades take planning; start now.

title: Minor version behind
condition: Two or more minor releases behind the latest for this major, or one behind where the missing release carries a CVE flag in versions.yml. Minor upgrades are a binary swap and a restart.

title: Slow-query logging disabled
condition: log_min_duration_statement = -1 and auto_explain is not loaded. 250-1000 ms plus log_min_duration_sample (13+) on busy systems is a workable starting point.

title: No evidence of a monitoring agent
condition: No role or application_name matching a known agent (datadog, newrelic, pgwatch, postgres_exporter, prometheus, pganalyze, zabbix, nagios, check_postgres, grafana, percona, pmm, sentry, dynatrace) and no monitoring extension. Confidence low: agents connect intermittently, or via a replica.

title: Settings changed but awaiting restart
condition: pg_settings.pending_restart = true for at least one setting. Someone believes a value is live; it is not.

title: restart_after_crash disabled
condition: restart_after_crash = off with no external supervisor recorded in baseline.supervisor. After any backend crash the cluster stays down until a human intervenes.

title: Error rate in the server log high
condition: 100 or more ERROR lines per hour on average over the last 24 hours, or any FATAL that is not connection-authentication noise. Deep pass; reports the top 5 message classes.

title: Very large table not partitioned
condition: pg_total_relation_size >= 200 GB and the relation is neither partitioned nor a partition. Vacuum, freeze, index builds and REINDEX all scale with the single relation. Advisory only.

title: Rows accumulating in a DEFAULT partition
condition: A default partition of 1 GB or more, or holding 10% or more of the parent's live tuples. Someone forgot to create the next partition, and every new ATTACH PARTITION must scan the default partition.

title: Large objects present (vacuumlo candidate)
condition: pg_largeobject is 10 GB or larger. Large objects orphaned by a deleted referencing row are never reclaimed without running vacuumlo.

title: Most client connections not using SSL
condition: ssl = on and fewer than 50% of non-local client backends have pg_stat_ssl.ssl = true.

title: Non-SCRAM password authentication in use
condition: password_encryption = 'md5', or roles whose stored password is md5-format, or pg_hba rules using md5/password/ident. SCRAM-SHA-256 has been available since 10 and md5 is deprecated.

title: trust authentication on the local socket
condition: A pg_hba rule with type = 'local' and auth_method = 'trust'. Anyone with a shell on the host is superuser. P100 rather than P1 because it requires host access, which is itself usually controlled.

title: Non-superuser roles with server file access
condition: Members of pg_read_server_files, pg_write_server_files or pg_execute_server_program that are not superusers. Each of those is effectively superuser.

title: PUBLIC can CREATE in schema public
condition: PUBLIC holds CREATE on schema public. This is the CVE-2018-1058 trojan-function vector; PostgreSQL 15 removed the default grant.

title: SECURITY DEFINER functions without a fixed search_path
condition: pg_proc.prosecdef is true and proconfig has no search_path entry, excluding pg_catalog and extension-owned functions. Same vulnerability class as SEC-013.

title: Estimated table bloat over 30 percent (200 MB or more wasted)
condition: Estimated bloat >= 30% AND estimated wasted bytes >= 200 MB, excluding relations already reported by VAC-006.

title: Autovacuum throttled at defaults on a large database
condition: Total size of the scanned databases >= 500 GB while autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit is -1 (inheriting vacuum_cost_limit 200) and autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay >= 2 ms. The resulting dirty-page throughput per worker is computed from vacuum_cost_page_dirty and reported in the finding.

title: Tables with autovacuum disabled via a storage parameter
condition: pg_class.reloptions contains autovacuum_enabled=false. Details include n_dead_tup and last_vacuum so you can see whether anything is vacuuming them at all.

title: Very large tables using the default vacuum scale factor
condition: reltuples >= 100,000,000 and no per-table autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor or autovacuum_vacuum_threshold override. 20% of 100 M rows is 20 M dead tuples before the first vacuum.

title: Autovacuum cancelled by lock conflicts (server log)
condition: At least 10 'canceling autovacuum task' messages in the last 24 hours of server log. Deep pass only; requires log access.

title: Insert-only tables never vacuumed (PostgreSQL 12 and older)
condition: PostgreSQL 12 and older only: n_tup_ins >= 10,000,000, n_tup_upd + n_tup_del = 0, and the table has never been vacuumed. Before 13 autovacuum ignores insert-only tables, so they are frozen only by the anti-wraparound path and never get a visibility map.

title: max_wal_size at the default on a write-active primary
condition: max_wal_size is 1 GB and WAL generation is 1 GB/hour or more (from pg_stat_wal since reset on 14+, otherwise from the checkpoint rate). Complements WAL-001.

title: Backends forced to write or fsync their own buffers
condition: pg_stat_bgwriter.buffers_backend_fsync > 0 or backend writes exceed checkpointer plus background-writer writes (<=16); from 16 the same signal is read from pg_stat_io for backend_type 'client backend'. The checkpointer and background writer cannot keep up.

title: WAL buffers overflowing
condition: pg_stat_wal.wal_buffers_full >= 10% of wal_write and >= 100,000 since reset. Raising wal_buffers requires a restart.

title: Slow checkpoint sync phase
condition: Average checkpoint sync_time is 5 seconds or more per checkpoint. Storage fsync latency is high, which shows up as commit latency spikes.

title: vacuum_failsafe_age raised above the default
condition: vacuum_failsafe_age or vacuum_multixact_failsafe_age > 1,600,000,000. The failsafe (which drops cost delays and index cleanup) is the last automatic defence against wraparound.

title: Log directory large
condition: Sum of pg_ls_logdir() sizes is 10 GB or more. Check log_rotation_age, log_rotation_size, log_truncate_on_rotation and log_min_duration_statement.

title: statement_timeout unset globally
condition: statement_timeout = 0 at server level with no per-role or per-database override in pg_db_role_setting. Set it per application role rather than globally.

title: Reserved: invalid indexes are reported by PG-IDX-001
condition: Never emits. The row exists so the identifier is never reused.

title: wal_sync_method changed from the platform default
condition: pg_settings.source for wal_sync_method is not 'default'. Almost never the right thing to change; listed for review.

title: Unused index (small, or usage statistics too young)
condition: idx_scan = 0 and size >= 50 MB, not already reported by IDX-002 (smaller than 1 GB or statistics younger than 30 days). Summary form.

title: Estimated B-tree bloat over 30 percent (100 MB or more wasted)
condition: Estimated index bloat >= 30% and >= 100 MB wasted, excluding indexes already reported by IDX-006.

title: Unindexed foreign key (small table)
condition: As PG-IDX-008 but the child is smaller than 100 MB and it does not reach PG-IDX-018 either - the parent is below 10,000 updates plus deletes a day, or the child holds fewer than 100,000 rows. Capped at the 20 largest, with the full count of unindexed foreign keys in details and evidence so the cap never hides the size of the backlog.

title: Sequential scans on mid-size tables
condition: As IDX-010 for tables between 100 MB and 1 GB. Summary form.

title: Index footprint more than twice the heap on a large table
condition: Table 1 GB or larger with pg_indexes_size >= 2 x pg_table_size. An informational pointer to IDX-002, 004, 005 and 012.

title: Wide B-tree indexes
condition: A B-tree index with 6 or more key columns and a size of 100 MB or more. Each entry carries every key column in every leaf and internal page.

title: Single-column index on a very low-cardinality column
condition: A single-column, non-partial B-tree index whose column has pg_stats.n_distinct between 1 and 3 (booleans, status flags) on a table 100 MB or larger. A partial index is usually the better shape.

title: GIN index with a large pending list
condition: pgstatginindex().pending_pages x 8 kB >= 64 MB on GIN indexes of 100 MB or more. Deep pass; requires the pgstattuple extension.

title: Deadlocks occurring regularly
condition: pg_stat_database.deadlocks divided by days since stats reset is 1 per day or more, with at least 7 deadlocks total. Usually an application lock-ordering bug; log_lock_waits and deadlock_timeout help diagnose it.

title: lock_timeout unset
condition: lock_timeout = 0 at server level. A migration's ALTER TABLE queued behind a long transaction blocks every statement that arrives behind it.

title: random_page_cost at the spinning-disk default
condition: random_page_cost = 4 while baseline.storage is ssd, nvme, cloud or unknown. On SSD and cloud storage 1.1-1.5 is typical. Confidence low when storage is unknown.

title: Buffer cache hit ratio below 90 percent
condition: blks_hit / (blks_hit + blks_read) < 0.90 for databases with at least 1,000,000 block reads. Confidence low: the operating-system cache masks this and analytic workloads legitimately read from disk. Reported for correlation with MEM-001/002, not as a target.

title: pg_stat_statements evicting entries
condition: pg_stat_statements_info.dealloc >= 1,000 since reset, or 100 or more per day. The top-N lists are unreliable while entries are being evicted; raise pg_stat_statements.max (needs a restart).

title: Plan-hostile patterns in top statements
condition: Regular-expression scan of the top 50 statements by total time for: leading-wildcard LIKE, lower()/upper() equality without a matching expression index, NOT IN (SELECT, ORDER BY random(), OFFSET of five digits or more, SELECT * on large tables, and unfiltered count(*). Confidence low: these are regexes over normalised text.

title: track_io_timing disabled
condition: track_io_timing = off. The I/O-time columns of pg_stat_statements are zero and EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) has no timing. The cost of enabling it is small on modern clocks; measure with pg_test_timing first.

title: Plan-instability candidates (high standard deviation)
condition: Statements with at least 1,000 calls where stddev_exec_time >= 3 x mean_exec_time and mean >= 10 ms. Parameter-sensitive plans, cache effects, or wildly varying result sizes.

title: compute_query_id off
condition: compute_query_id is 'off', or 'auto' with no query-id provider loaded. pg_stat_activity.query_id is then null and log correlation to pg_stat_statements is impossible.

title: High-frequency statements returning almost no rows
condition: At least 1,000,000 calls with fewer than 0.01 rows returned per call. Polling loops and existence checks that should be cached or event-driven.

title: Diagnostic logging off
condition: Any of log_checkpoints = off (the pre-15 default), log_lock_waits = off, log_autovacuum_min_duration = -1, log_temp_files = -1, or a log_line_prefix lacking %m or %p. One finding listing which.

title: Extension updates available
condition: pg_available_extensions.default_version differs from installed_version for an installed extension. ALTER EXTENSION ... UPDATE applies it.

title: Logging collector off with a stderr-only destination
condition: logging_collector = off and log_destination is stderr only. On a self-managed host outside a container this usually means the log is going nowhere useful. Confidence low.

title: hot_standby_feedback on with long-running standby queries
condition: On a standby with hot_standby_feedback = on, the longest active query is 30 minutes or older. That query is pinning the primary's xmin horizon (see PG-VAC-005 on the primary).

title: Tables without a primary key or unique index
condition: An ordinary table with no valid indisprimary or indisunique index. Logical replication cannot replicate UPDATE or DELETE, de-duplication is manual, and many ORMs and CDC tools misbehave. Summary form listing the 10 largest.

title: REPLICA IDENTITY FULL on published tables
condition: A published table with relreplident = 'f'. Every UPDATE and DELETE ships the whole old row and the subscriber does a full-table lookup unless it has a matching index.

title: Partitioned table with more than 1,000 partitions
condition: A partitioned table with 1,000 or more direct children. Planning time and lock acquisition scale with the partition count on queries that cannot be pruned.

title: Triggers on high-write tables
condition: A table with 1,000,000 or more writes since the statistics reset carrying at least one non-internal trigger. Informational: triggers are where surprising write latency hides.

title: Database with more than 10,000 relations
condition: 10,000 or more entries in pg_class for tables, indexes, toast tables and partitions in one database. Catalog bloat, autovacuum scheduling latency and slow information_schema queries follow.

title: Unpopulated materialized view
condition: pg_class with relkind = 'm' and relispopulated = false. Any query against it raises an error.

title: User tables readable by PUBLIC
condition: A relation in a user schema with SELECT granted to PUBLIC. Sometimes deliberate; listed for review.

title: Untrusted procedural languages or risky extensions installed
condition: An untrusted language (plpython3u, plperlu, pltclu) or a high-risk extension (adminpack, file_fdw, dblink) is installed. Function authors in those languages can run arbitrary code as the server account.

title: Low HOT-update ratio on update-heavy tables
condition: n_tup_upd >= 1,000,000 and n_tup_hot_upd / n_tup_upd < 0.10 and fillfactor is unset. A lower fillfactor helps only when the updated columns are not indexed, which cannot be verified from the catalog, so confidence is low.

title: checkpoint_completion_target below 0.9
condition: checkpoint_completion_target < 0.9. The pre-14 default of 0.5 concentrates checkpoint writes into the first half of the interval.

title: Background writer hitting its per-round limit
condition: pg_stat_bgwriter.maxwritten_clean >= 1,000 per day since the statistics reset. bgwriter_lru_maxpages is stopping the cleaning scan early.

title: WAL compression off with a high full-page-image ratio
condition: pg_stat_wal.wal_fpi / wal_records >= 0.3 while wal_compression is off. From 15 lz4 and zstd are available and cheap.

title: Non-default server settings
condition: pg_settings where source is not 'default' or 'override' and the current value differs from boot_val, excluding an identity and locale noise list. One finding per setting; the renderer collapses these into a summary when there are more than 60.

title: Per-database and per-role setting overrides
condition: Any row in pg_db_role_setting. Overrides of synchronous_commit, work_mem and statement_timeout especially change how the server behaves for one application without appearing in postgresql.conf.

title: Per-relation storage parameters
condition: Any non-toast relation with a non-null reloptions: fillfactor, autovacuum_*, parallel_workers, toast_tuple_target.

title: Settings applied via ALTER SYSTEM
condition: pg_settings.sourcefile ends in postgresql.auto.conf. Distinguishes configuration-management-owned settings from ad-hoc ones applied at a psql prompt.

title: Settings differing from the supplied baseline
condition: Any difference from baseline.settings in .db-triage.yml, or from a --baseline JSONL run. A fleet-consistency tool: it answers 'why is this node different'.

title: Index build in progress
condition: Any row in pg_stat_progress_create_index. Context for the operator: it explains locks, load and WAL volume during the run.

title: Foreign keys or check constraints NOT VALID
condition: pg_constraint.convalidated = false. Integrity is enforced for new rows only; existing rows were never checked.

title: Legacy inheritance-based partitioning
condition: A pg_inherits parent that is not in pg_partitioned_table. Inventory: constraint exclusion rather than partition pruning, and no declarative partition maintenance.

title: Login roles with expired passwords
condition: Login roles with rolvaliduntil in the past. Cleanup candidates: the role still exists and still holds its grants.

title: Login roles with no password expiry
condition: Count of login roles with rolvaliduntil null. Expiry is uncommon in PostgreSQL because secret managers rotate instead, so this is a review row and not a problem.

title: Connection logging disabled
condition: log_connections and log_disconnections are both off. Post-incident forensics on who connected from where is impossible.

title: Superuser roles
condition: Inventory of roles with rolsuper and rolcanlogin, excluding platform-owned roles and baseline.expected_superusers.

title: Roles with elevated attributes
condition: Login roles with rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolreplication or rolbypassrls, excluding superusers already listed by SEC-009.

title: Login roles with no password set
condition: Login roles whose pg_authid.rolpassword is null. Correct with peer, cert or LDAP authentication; a lockout or an exposure signal otherwise. The password column is tested for null only and never read into the report.

title: Top 10 statements by total execution time
condition: Always, when pg_stat_statements is readable: the 10 statements with the highest total execution time, with percentage of total, calls, mean ms, rows per call, shared blocks read, temp blocks written and WAL bytes.

title: Top 10 statements by mean execution time
condition: The 10 statements with the highest mean execution time among those with at least 100 calls.

title: Top 10 statements by I/O
condition: The 10 statements with the highest shared_blks_read + temp_blks_read + temp_blks_written.

title: Top 10 statements by call count
condition: The 10 most frequently executed statements. N+1 query patterns and polling loops surface here.

title: Top 10 statements by WAL generated
condition: The 10 statements with the highest wal_bytes (pg_stat_statements 1.8, PostgreSQL 13+). Write amplification and replication load come from here.

title: Wait-event snapshot
condition: Always: a histogram of wait_event_type and wait_event for active non-background sessions at snapshot time. In deep mode this is sampled three times at one-second intervals.

title: Database sizes
condition: Always: pg_database_size() per database, the cluster total, and the tablespace each database lives in.

title: Largest 20 relations
condition: Always, per scanned database: the 20 largest by pg_total_relation_size, split into heap, index and toast bytes.

title: Growth since last snapshot
condition: When a previous snapshot exists: per-database and top-relation growth per day between the two runs.

title: Server identity
condition: Always: version, server_version_num, start time and uptime, recovery state, system identifier, cluster_name, data_checksums, wal_level, max_connections, shared_buffers, TimeZone and server encoding.

title: Host resources
condition: CPU count, RAM, swap, storage rotational flag, filesystem of the data directory and container detection, from the host helper; otherwise 'unknown, supply baseline.ram_gb'.

title: Installed extensions
condition: Always, per scanned database: installed extensions with their installed and default versions, flagging those that require shared_preload_libraries.

title: Replication topology
condition: Always: this node's role, connected standbys with application name, address, state, sync_state and lag; replication slots with type, plugin, activity and retained WAL; subscriptions and publications; synchronous_standby_names. primary_conninfo is reported with any password masked.

title: Connection summary
condition: Always: connection counts by state and by database, the top 10 application names, the number of distinct client addresses and the oldest backend_start.

title: Autovacuum configuration
condition: Always: every autovacuum and vacuum setting with its value and source, so the VAC and WRAP findings can be read against the configuration that produced them.

title: Object counts
condition: Always, per scanned database: pg_class counts by relkind, schema count, partition count and user function count.

title: Checkpoint, background writer, WAL and archiver rates
condition: Always: per-hour rates since the statistics reset for checkpoints (timed and requested), buffers written, WAL bytes and records (14+), and archived and failed WAL files, each with the reset timestamp it is measured from.

title: Roles summary
condition: Always: counts of total, login-capable, superuser, replication, createrole, createdb and bypassrls roles, with platform-owned roles counted separately.

title: pg_hba summary
condition: One row per (connection type, authentication method) with the rule count, the line numbers, and the addresses, databases and roles matched. Skipped without the privilege to read pg_hba_file_rules; SEC-012 then says so.

title: Tablespaces
condition: Always: tablespace names, owners, locations and sizes. A non-default tablespace is usually a different volume with its own free space and its own failure mode.

title: Statistics window
condition: Always: the earliest stats_reset across the statistics views and the server uptime, expressed as 'counters cover N days'. Every rate in this report depends on it, so it is printed near the top.

title: Checks skipped
condition: Any registry check eligible for this engine/version/role did not run; details list each with reason in {privilege, version, platform, standby, cost, user-skip, timeout, error, no-input, embedded-subset, planned}.

title: Insufficient privileges for core visibility
condition: Connected role is not a member of pg_monitor and lacks pg_read_all_stats, so pg_stat_activity.query and pg_stat_statements rows for other users are masked.

title: Statistics reset within 24 hours
condition: Any of pg_stat_database.stats_reset, pg_stat_bgwriter/pg_stat_checkpointer.stats_reset or pg_stat_statements_info.stats_reset is within 24 h; every counter-based finding becomes confidence=low.

title: db-triage registry is stale
condition: registry.csv generated_at older than 365 days, or reference/versions.yml as_of older than 180 days; EOL and latest-minor checks become confidence=low.

title: Target is a standby/replica
condition: pg_is_in_recovery() is true; primary-only checks are skipped and usage counters are this instance's only.

title: Managed platform detected; checks adapted
condition: A platform fingerprint from reference/platforms.md matched; details list checks skipped or re-prioritised.

title: Run limited to N of M databases / relation sampling in effect
condition: More databases exist than were scanned (fast-pass cap 5), or a scanned database has more than 50,000 relations so per-relation checks used top-N sampling.

title: Interview questions unanswered
condition: Any source=interview check has no recorded answer in .db-triage.yml interview:, or the answer is older than 180 days.

title: Run metadata
condition: Always. Target label, engine, version, role, platform, mode, DSN host (never the password), start/end, duration, checks run/skipped/suppressed, db-triage and registry versions.

title: db-triage credits
condition: Always, unless suppressed. db-triage version and repository URL.

title: InnoDB corruption messages in the error log
condition: InnoDB integrity messages in performance_schema.error_log within the lookback window.

title: Replica lag over 5 minutes
condition: Applier lag >= 300 s.

title: Group Replication member not ONLINE
condition: A group member is not ONLINE, or the group has fewer than 3 members.

title: Crash-recovery messages in the error log
condition: Crash or unclean-shutdown messages in performance_schema.error_log.

title: GTID set has gaps
condition: gtid_executed contains more intervals than source UUIDs.

title: Replica lag over 30 seconds
condition: Applier lag >= 30 s and < 300 s.

title: Persisted variables override the configuration files
condition: A persisted variable overrides a file-sourced value.

title: sql_require_primary_key off while primary-key-less tables exist
condition: sql_require_primary_key OFF while primary-key-less tables exist.

title: Persisted variables (inventory)
condition: Always emitted when persisted variables exist.

title: Accounts without password expiry (review)
condition: Accounts inherit an unlimited default_password_lifetime.

title: Query cache enabled
condition: query_cache_type not OFF with a non-zero query_cache_size.

title: Checkpoint age near redo capacity
condition: Checkpoint age >= 75% of its maximum.

title: Per-account workload profile (MariaDB user statistics)
condition: Always emitted when userstat is ON.

title: Binary logging disabled — point-in-time recovery impossible
condition: log_bin = OFF on a self-managed primary.

title: Last successful backup unknown or older than 7 days
condition: No backup tool output found, or newest backup >= 7 days old.

title: Data, binary log or temp volume at or above 90 percent full
condition: A MySQL volume is >= 90% full.

title: InnoDB doublewrite buffer disabled
condition: innodb_doublewrite is OFF or DETECT_ONLY.

title: Server running in innodb_force_recovery mode
condition: innodb_force_recovery > 0.

title: End-of-life server reachable from any network interface
condition: MY-REL-001 fired, the server listens on all interfaces, and wildcard-host accounts exist.
reads: as MY-REL-001, plus @@GLOBAL.bind_address, @@GLOBAL.skip_networking, and the wildcard-host account count

title: Replication stopped with an error
condition: A replication thread is not running and an error is recorded.

title: Accounts with no password
condition: An unlocked, non-external-auth account has an empty credential.

title: Superuser-equivalent account reachable from any host
condition: An account with SUPER or all privileges has a wildcard host pattern.

title: Connections at or above 90 percent of max_connections
condition: Threads_connected or Max_used_connections >= 90% of max_connections.

title: Crash-unsafe replication source
condition: MY-DUR-001 and MY-DUR-002 both true and replicas are connected.

title: AUTO_INCREMENT at or above 90 percent exhausted
condition: AUTO_INCREMENT >= 90% of the column type maximum.

title: Anonymous accounts present
condition: An account with an empty username exists.

title: InnoDB history list length very high
condition: InnoDB history list length >= 1,000,000 undo records.

title: innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit not 1
condition: innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit is 0 or 2.

title: sync_binlog not 1
condition: log_bin ON and sync_binlog <> 1.

title: Transaction waiting on a row lock for over 5 minutes
condition: A transaction has waited >= 300 s for a row lock.

title: Idle transaction holding locks for over an hour
condition: An idle transaction has held row locks >= 1 h.

title: Server restarted within the last 24 hours
condition: Uptime < 86,400 s.

title: Replication threads stopped without an error
condition: A replication thread is not running and no error is recorded.

title: Replica is writable
condition: Replica with read_only OFF or super_read_only OFF.

title: Binary log retention shorter than one day
condition: Effective binary log retention < 86,400 s.

title: Volume at or above 80 percent full
condition: A MySQL volume is >= 80% full.

title: Projected disk-full within 30 days
condition: Projected disk-full within 30 days from snapshot growth.

title: Clients refused because max_connections was reached
condition: Connection_errors_max_connections > 0.

title: Transaction open for over an hour
condition: A transaction has been open >= 1 h.

title: InnoDB buffer pool at the shipped default
condition: innodb_buffer_pool_size <= 128 MB with innodb_dedicated_server OFF.

title: Server version is past end of life
condition: The server's release branch is past its end-of-life date.
reads: @@GLOBAL.version, @dbt_fork, and the embedded release table below

title: InnoDB tables without a primary key on a replicated source
condition: An InnoDB table has no primary key and row-based binary logging is in use.

title: Binary logs never expire
condition: log_bin ON and both retention variables are 0.

title: Restore never tested or RPO/RTO undocumented
condition: Last restore test > 90 days, never, or unknown.

title: Binary logs consuming excessive space
condition: Binary logs occupy >= 100 GB or >= 25% of data size.

title: General query log enabled
condition: general_log = ON.

title: Connections at or above 70 percent of max_connections
condition: Threads_connected or Max_used_connections >= 70% and < 90%.

title: max_connections very high with no thread pool and no evidence of a pooler
condition: max_connections >= 1000, no thread pool, and connections are not concentrated.

title: Server saturated at snapshot time
condition: Threads_running >= 2 per core, or >= 64 when cores are unknown.

title: InnoDB page checksums disabled
condition: innodb_checksum_algorithm = none.
reads: @dbt_v_innodb_checksum_algorithm (bundle: present in MySQL 5.6+ and MariaDB 10.x, but read through the bundle so a fork that drops it yields NULL and this check stays silent instead of erroring)

title: Non-transactional storage engines in use
condition: Any user table uses a non-transactional storage engine.

title: Unused index of 1 GB or more
condition: An index >= 1 GB has zero reads since restart.
reads: sys.schema_unused_indexes, or performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_index_usage directly; mysql.innodb_index_stats (stat_name='size') x @@innodb_page_size for size

title: Redundant or duplicate indexes
condition: An index is a leftmost prefix of, or identical to, another index.
reads: sys.schema_redundant_indexes, or an information_schema.STATISTICS self-join where sys is absent

title: Large table with heavy full table scans
condition: A table >= 1 GB has >= 10 M rows read without an index.
reads: sys.schema_tables_with_full_table_scans (object_schema, object_name, rows_full_scanned), information_schema.TABLES for size

title: Transaction waiting on a row lock for over 30 seconds
condition: A transaction has waited >= 30 s and < 300 s for a row lock.

title: Idle transaction holding locks for over 5 minutes
condition: An idle transaction has held row locks >= 5 min and < 1 h.

title: Sessions waiting for a metadata lock
condition: A session has waited >= 30 s for a table metadata lock.

title: Buffer pool far smaller than the InnoDB working set
condition: Buffer pool < 25% of InnoDB data and < 50% of RAM where RAM is known.

title: Worst-case memory commitment exceeds host RAM
condition: Worst-case memory commitment >= host RAM, or RAM unknown.
reads: @@GLOBAL.innodb_buffer_pool_size, innodb_log_buffer_size, key_buffer_size, max_connections, sort/join/read/read_rnd buffers, binlog_cache_size, thread_stack, tmp_table_size, @dbt_ram_bytes

title: Host is swapping
condition: Swap in use >= 1 GB, or non-zero swap-in/swap-out.

title: GTID not in use in a replicated topology
condition: Replication configured and GTID not in use.

title: Statement-based binary logging
condition: log_bin ON and binlog_format = STATEMENT.

title: Replication errors are being skipped
condition: skip_errors is set, or exec_mode is IDEMPOTENT.

title: Semi-synchronous replication has fallen back to asynchronous
condition: Semi-sync enabled but its status variable reads OFF.

title: Replication filters configured
condition: Any replication filter is configured.
reads: performance_schema.replication_applier_filters / replication_applier_global_filters (MySQL 8.0.1+); @dbt_v_replicate_* bundle variables (MariaDB, and MySQL where the performance_schema tables are unavailable)

title: sql_mode is not strict
condition: Global sql_mode lacks a STRICT mode or a zero-date restriction.
reads: @dbt_global_sql_mode (the GLOBAL value captured in 01_session.sql BEFORE this session changed its own sql_mode)

title: AUTO_INCREMENT at or above 70 percent exhausted
condition: AUTO_INCREMENT >= 70% and < 90% of the column type maximum.

title: Integrity checks disabled globally
condition: foreign_key_checks or unique_checks is OFF at global scope.

title: Shared InnoDB tablespace in use
condition: innodb_file_per_table OFF, or tables remain in the system tablespace.

title: Application connections running as a privileged account
condition: >= 5 concurrent non-local connections from a privileged account.
reads: information_schema.PROCESSLIST joined to the normalised account source

title: InnoDB history list length elevated
condition: InnoDB history list length >= 100,000 and < 1,000,000.

title: Undo tablespaces large
condition: Undo storage >= 10 GB, or >= 2 GB with innodb_undo_log_truncate OFF.
reads: information_schema.FILES (MySQL 8.0, FILE_TYPE='UNDO LOG'); information_schema.INNODB_SYS_TABLESPACES (MariaDB, NAME LIKE 'innodb_undo%'); @@GLOBAL.innodb_undo_tablespaces, @@GLOBAL.innodb_undo_log_truncate

title: Redo log capacity below one hour of writes
condition: Redo capacity holds less than one hour of the observed redo write rate.

title: Binary log checksums off
condition: binlog_checksum = NONE with log_bin ON.

title: Managed-platform backups not verifiable from SQL
condition: A managed platform was fingerprinted.

title: InnoDB temporary tablespace large
condition: The InnoDB temporary tablespace is >= 10 GB.

title: Aborted connections high
condition: Aborted_connects or Aborted_clients >= 1% of Connections.

title: Host approaching the connect-error block threshold
condition: A host has reached 50% of max_connect_errors.

title: Most connections are sleeping
condition: >= 80% of >= 100 connections idle with wait_timeout >= 28,800 s.

title: Replica not crash-safe
condition: Replica with relay_log_recovery OFF, or FILE-based position repositories.

title: Write-heavy table carrying many indexes
condition: A table with >= 10 indexes has taken >= 1 M row writes.

title: Table fragmentation (DATA_FREE) high
condition: DATA_FREE >= 30% of data plus index on a table >= 1 GB.

title: Query running for over 10 minutes
condition: A non-replication query has run >= 600 s.

title: Buffer pool over 80 percent of host RAM
condition: Buffer pool >= 80% of host RAM.

title: Buffer pool read miss rate high
condition: Buffer pool miss rate >= 5% over >= 10 M read requests.

title: Implicit temporary tables spilling to disk
condition: Disk temp table ratio >= 25% and >= 1,000/hour.

title: Oversized per-session buffers
condition: Any per-session buffer >= 8 MB globally.

title: Table open cache too small, or open-file limit at risk
condition: Table cache overflows >= 1/min, Opened_tables >= 10/s, or open files >= 80% of the limit.

title: performance_schema disabled
condition: performance_schema = OFF.

title: Slow query log off, or its threshold at the default
condition: slow_query_log OFF, or long_query_time >= 10 s.

title: One statement digest dominates total latency
condition: One digest holds >= 25% of total statement time with >= 1,000 executions.

title: Join and scan counters high
condition: Select_full_join >= 1% or Select_scan >= 20% of Questions.

title: Server version within six months of end of life
condition: The server's release branch reaches end of life within 180 days.

title: Patch release behind
condition: The server is >= 2 patch releases behind its branch.

title: No evidence of a monitoring agent
condition: No account or session name matches a known monitoring agent.

title: Single-threaded replica applier while lagging
condition: Replica lagging with <= 1 applier worker.

title: Replication heartbeat or connection retry misconfigured
condition: Retry interval >= 600 s, retry count 0, or heartbeat interval 0.

title: binlog_row_image MINIMAL with logical consumers configured
condition: binlog_row_image = MINIMAL with logical consumers declared.

title: InnoDB tables without a primary key
condition: An InnoDB table has no primary key and row-based binary logging is not in use.

title: Leftover online-schema-change artefacts
condition: A shadow table or pt-osc trigger from an interrupted schema change remains.

title: Application accounts allowed from any host
condition: A non-privileged account has a wildcard host pattern.

title: TLS not enforced, or largely unused
condition: require_secure_transport OFF and TLS used by < 50% of connections.

title: LOAD DATA LOCAL enabled
condition: local_infile = ON.

title: FILE privilege unrestricted by secure_file_priv
condition: secure_file_priv empty and at least one account holds FILE.

title: Purge threads at default on a server that is not purging fast enough
condition: MY-UNDO-002 fired and innodb_purge_threads <= 4.

title: Redo log buffer waits
condition: Innodb_log_waits > 0 and >= 1/hour.

title: Thread cache misses
condition: Threads_created >= 1% of Connections over >= 100,000 connections.

title: DNS lookups performed on every connection
condition: skip_name_resolve = OFF.

title: No integrity verification practice
condition: No integrity verification practice reported in the interview.

title: Unused index (smaller, or statistics window too short)
condition: An index >= 50 MB and < 1 GB has zero reads since restart.
reads: sys.schema_unused_indexes, or performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_index_usage directly; mysql.innodb_index_stats (stat_name='size') x @@innodb_page_size for size

title: Single-column index on a very low-cardinality column
condition: A single-column index has cardinality <= 3 on a table >= 100 MB.

title: InnoDB persistent statistics stale
condition: InnoDB statistics >= 30 days old, or innodb_stats_persistent OFF.

title: Wide composite indexes
condition: An index spans >= 6 columns on a table >= 100 MB.
reads: information_schema.STATISTICS (SEQ_IN_INDEX, SUB_PART), information_schema.COLUMNS for the declared widths

title: Deadlocks occurring regularly
condition: >= 1 deadlock/day with >= 7 total.

title: Table-level lock waits
condition: Table lock waits >= 1% of table lock requests.

title: Single buffer pool instance with a large pool
condition: Pool >= 8 GB with innodb_buffer_pool_instances = 1.

title: innodb_flush_method not O_DIRECT on Linux
condition: innodb_flush_method not O_DIRECT on Linux with a pool >= 4 GB.

title: Statement digest instrumentation incomplete
condition: statements_digest consumer disabled, or digests lost > 0.

title: Statements failing or warning frequently
condition: A digest errors on >= 5% of >= 1,000 executions.

title: Sort merge passes high
condition: Sort_merge_passes >= 10/s.

title: Plan-hostile patterns in top statement digests
condition: A top digest matches a plan-hostile text pattern.

title: sys schema missing
condition: The sys schema has no views.

title: Error log verbosity reduced
condition: Error log verbosity is below its default.

title: Very large table not partitioned
condition: A single-partition table is >= 200 GB.

title: Table with more than 1,000 partitions
condition: A table has >= 1,000 partitions.

title: Triggers on high-write tables
condition: A table with >= 1 trigger has taken >= 1 M writes.

title: Character set or collation inconsistent within a schema
condition: A schema contains more than one table collation.

title: Deprecated or weak authentication plugins
condition: An account uses mysql_native_password, mysql_old_password or sha256_password.

title: No password validation policy
condition: No password validation plugin or component is active.

title: Legacy test database or test grants present
condition: The legacy test schema exists.

title: Binary log cache spilling to disk
condition: Binlog cache disk-use ratio >= 1% with >= 10,000 uses.

title: innodb_io_capacity at its rotational-disk default on solid-state storage
condition: io_capacity at defaults with baseline.storage declared as ssd, nvme or cloud.

title: Buffer pool dirty page ratio high
condition: Dirty page ratio >= 75% at snapshot.

title: Non-default global variables
condition: Always emitted; one row per non-default global variable.
reads: MySQL: performance_schema.variables_info joined to global_variables; MariaDB: information_schema.SYSTEM_VARIABLES (GLOBAL_VALUE vs DEFAULT_VALUE)

title: Variables differing from the supplied baseline
condition: A supplied baseline differs from the running configuration.

title: Buffer pool warm-up not configured (review)
condition: Buffer pool dump-at-shutdown or load-at-startup is OFF.

title: server_id left at its default in a replicated topology
condition: server_id is 0 or 1 in a replicated topology.

title: Legacy character sets and row formats (inventory)
condition: Tables use a legacy character set or a pre-Barracuda row format.

title: Listening on all interfaces (review)
condition: bind_address is unrestricted and skip_networking is OFF.

title: No audit logging (review)
condition: No audit plugin or component is active.

title: Privileged accounts (review list)
condition: An account holds any global privilege that escapes its own scope.

title: Top 10 statements by total latency
condition: Always emitted when digests are available.

title: Top 10 statements by average latency
condition: Always emitted when digests are available.

title: Top 10 statements by rows examined per row sent
condition: Rows examined per row sent >= 100 with >= 100 executions.

title: Top 10 statements creating disk temporary tables
condition: Statements with disk temporary tables exist.

title: Top 10 statements with full table scans
condition: Statements that executed with no index exist.

title: Top 10 statements by execution count
condition: Always emitted when digests are available.

title: Status snapshot
condition: Always emitted.

title: Schema sizes
condition: Always emitted.

title: Largest 20 tables
condition: Always emitted.

title: Growth since last snapshot
condition: A previous snapshot exists to compare against.

title: Server identity
condition: Always emitted.
reads: version and fork facts from 01_session.sql plus the universal settings

title: Host resources
condition: Always emitted when host resources are supplied.

title: Plugins and components
condition: Always emitted.

title: Replication topology
condition: Always emitted.
reads: the normalised replica status from 01_session.sql §6c, @dbt_binlog_dump_threads, semi-sync status, GTID variables

title: Connection summary
condition: Always emitted.

title: InnoDB summary
condition: Always emitted.
reads: InnoDB settings (universal ones inline, fork-specific ones from the bundle), information_schema.TABLES for data size by engine

title: Object counts
condition: Always emitted.
reads: information_schema TABLES, VIEWS, ROUTINES, TRIGGERS, EVENTS, PARTITIONS, STATISTICS, TABLE_CONSTRAINTS

title: Accounts summary
condition: Always emitted.

title: Statistics window
condition: Always emitted.
